Correlates of War War Counts, by Year (1816-2007)

Source: R/data.R
cowwaryears.Rd

This is a simple data set of the number of ongoing wars in a given year, using the Correlates of War data.

Usage

cowwaryears

Format

A data frame with 768 rows and three columns

year

a numeric vector for the year

cat

the type of war ("Extra-state", "Inter-state", "Intra-state", "Non-State")

n

the number of ongoing wars in a year

Details

CoW inter-state wars and intra-state wars come pre-processed in peacesciencer. Data are version 4.0, except for intra-state wars (v. 4.1).

References

Dixon, Jeffrey, and Meredith Sarkees. 2016. A Guide to Intra-State Wars: An Examination of Civil Wars, 1816-2014. Thousand Oaks, CA: Sage.

Sarkees, Meredith Reid, and Frank Wheldon Wayman. 2010. Resort to War: A Data Guide to Inter-State, Extra-State, Intra-State, and Non-State Wars, 1816-2007. Washington DC: CQ Press.
